operator.name: Prannavakanth
operator.mission_statement: Building agentic AI, generative AI, and data-driven solutions to solve real-world problems. Combining strong DSA fundamentals with end-to-end ML expertise to develop scalable, production-ready systems that drive measurable impact across industries.
operator.bio: I am Prannavakanth, an AI/ML Engineer passionate about building agentic AI, generative AI, and data-driven solutions. With expertise in end-to-end ML systems, I develop scalable, production-ready systems that drive measurable impact. My work spans AI-driven healthcare solutions, financial intelligence platforms, and smart farming assistants. I hold multiple patents and have been recognized with top honors in various hackathons including AnnamAI Hackathon at IIT Ropar, HackHub'25, and Vashisht 3.0.
